description.value: Mumbaiyaa is a purely vegetarian Mumbai street food restaurant in Burnaby, founded by Mumbai-born millennials who wanted to recreate the authentic snacks of their youth — from spicy Vada Pav to tangy Pani Puri and Pav Bhaji. The restaurant's name blends 'Mumbai' with 'yaa,' the Marathi word for 'come,' reflecting its mission to bring the communal, flavour-forward spirit of Mumbai's streets to Canada. Cyclists stopping here will find an entirely plant-based menu of bold Indian street food with a vibrant, eclectic atmosphere described as mirroring the streets of Mumbai.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms this is an active, purely vegetarian Mumbai street food restaurant operating primarily as an online order-ahead pickup model. A significant discrepancy exists: OSM lists the community as 'North Vancouver' but the website's About Us page says 'Nestled in the heart of Burnaby' and the Contact page gives the full address as '4160 Hastings Street, Burnaby, V5C 2J4' — the street address matches OSM but the city does not. No bike-specific amenities (parking, pump, Wi-Fi, washrooms) are mentioned anywhere on the website; vegetarian/vegan status is strongly confirmed by both OSM tags (diet:vegan=yes, diet:vegetarian=yes) and repeated website language ('purely vegetarian paradise', 'focus on pure vegetarian cuisine').
concerns: OSM community field says 'North Vancouver' but website About Us and Contact pages consistently identify the location as Burnaby; the full address is '4160 Hastings Street, Burnaby, V5C 2J4'.
OSM has no phone number listed; website contact page provides +1 604 327 4941.
OSM address is missing city and postal code, which the website supplies (Burnaby, V5C 2J4).
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: An active vegetarian Indian street food restaurant with a working online ordering system; a useful food stop for touring cyclists seeking plant-based options along Hastings Street in Burnaby.
